backups.title: Backup & Restore
backups.description: Create an encrypted backup of every account, configuration and attachment. Keep the encryption passphrase separately; it cannot be recovered.
backups.account_required: Sign in with your administrator account password or a passkey to manage instance backups. API tokens cannot authorize this operation.
backups.storage_required: An operator must configure private instance-backup storage on the server before backups can be created or uploaded.
backups.phrase_mismatch: The encryption passphrases do not match.
backups.phrase_help: Use 12–1024 characters. You will need this passphrase to validate and restore the backup.
backups.choose_file: Select the matching backup file and wait for its checksum before continuing.
backups.file_size: Choose a backup between 40 and {{maximum}} bytes.
backups.hash_failed: The file could not be read. Select it again.
backups.file_ready: File checksum complete. Ready to upload or resume.
backups.download_failed: The download could not be authorized. Refresh status and try again.
backups.download_started: Download handed to the browser. Check your downloads to confirm it completed.
backups.invalid_archive: Verification failed. Check the passphrase or select another archive. Uploaded ciphertext is retained for a retry.
backups.review_warning: The archive is verified, but restore activation is not yet available. Target readiness, authentication configuration, deployment mapping and offline activation are still required. No application data has been replaced.
backups.discard_help: Removes the staged archive and working files from this server. The operation audit is retained.
backups.error_file_mismatch: The selected file does not match this upload. Select the original encrypted backup.
backups.error_progress: The upload acknowledgement was inconsistent. Refresh status before resuming.
backups.error_in_progress: Another backup or restore operation is active. Review its status before starting another.
backups.error_size: The archive exceeds the configured storage or size limit.
backups.error_conflict: Uploaded bytes conflict with the staged archive. Select the original file or discard this upload.
backups.error_state: The operation changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
backups.error_download: The download authorization expired or was already used. Authorize a new download.
backups.target_eligible: The database contains only bootstrap data. Further restore checks are still required.
backups.target_blocked: This database contains existing data and cannot be replaced as an empty target.
backups.target_data: Business records or modified bootstrap labels exist.
backups.target_tokens: API token records exist, including any revoked tokens.
backups.target_history: Business changes or command receipts exist.
backups.target_advisory: This check does not reserve the database or authorize a restore. Activation must repeat it while writes are stopped, and complete authentication and deployment checks.
backups.invalid_authentication: The archive contains unsupported credentials or service settings. Repair the source and create a new backup. Discard this upload before uploading its replacement.
backups.error_restore_pending: Instance restore is pending. The server operator must complete recovery before requests can resume.
backups.error_restart_required: This server process must restart after an instance restore. Contact the server operator.
backups.error_maintenance: Instance maintenance is in progress. Try again shortly.
backups.error_fence: The instance maintenance state could not be verified. Contact the server operator.
backups.error_material_required: The recovered configuration for this installation is required before the server can start. Contact the server operator.
backups.review_preparation: The archive is verified. Prepare the destination mapping and private files, review the consequences, then confirm restoration. Existing data is preserved until exclusive startup recovery.
backups.stage_preparing: Preparing private restore files. You can leave this page and return to check progress.
backups.stage_failed: Preparation failed. Check the passphrase and destination configuration, then retry. No application data has been replaced.
backups.stage_help: Enter the destination public origin (or NONE for local access). Database credentials, listener ports and TLS stay with this destination. Source configuration and security files are retained privately.
backups.restore_consequences: Restoration replaces only an empty bootstrap installation. Original user IDs and credentials are preserved. Existing sessions and recovery links become invalid. Passkeys bound to another hostname require reenrollment. All target replicas must stop before recovery; the source installation stays unchanged.
backups.confirm_restore_help: Type {{confirmation}} to confirm the reviewed destination. Confirmation enters maintenance mode; restart is required.
backups.pending_restart: Stop every server process connected to the destination database, then start one destination server. Its startup helper completes the restore before opening HTTP. Other API operations remain unavailable until recovery finishes.
backups.pending_recovery: If startup is interrupted, start the server again to resume. Before the database is replaced, an operator can cancel offline using the original destination administrator password. After replacement, resume recovery. Keep the encrypted archive and its passphrase.

notes.select: Select a note from the navigation.

notes.binary: Binary attachment. Its bytes are preserved without conversion.

notes.invalid_link: This link cannot be resolved inside the collection.
notes.entry_count: Notes entries (including folders and deleted items)
notes.uncertain: The change could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Reload this item to review the saved version before editing again.
notes.settings_help: Changing a special folder moves its existing notes and preserves their calendar associations. Choose a destination without conflicting files.
notes.config_help: Configuration and plugin files are stored as opaque files. Dagsverk never runs synchronized plugins.

notes.error_config_present: Delete or move the synchronized .obsidian files before turning off configuration synchronization.
notes.error_special_folder: Change this special folder in Notes settings.
notes.error_association: This move would change a journal or event association. Use Notes settings to move its folder.

notes.ambiguous_wikilink: Several documents match this link. Use the full path from the collection root.

notes.hide_journal_help: Hide the journal folder, including its notes and assets, from Notes navigation and search. Journal views, links and synchronization remain available.
markdown.revision_help: Compare a saved version with your current draft. “Use as unsaved draft” restores its text; save the note to keep it. History retains up to 20 versions per note, 1000 per account and 8 MB in total.
markdown.no_revisions: No earlier revisions have been recorded.
markdown.embed_sizing: Store sizing as an Obsidian embed
markdown.image_sizing_help: Ordinary Markdown images keep their alternative text. Sized Obsidian embeds use the filename as alternative text; leave height empty to keep the aspect ratio.
markdown.invalid_image: Choose a width and optional height from 1 to 2000 pixels.
markdown.tab_help: Tab indents. Press Escape, then Tab to move focus out of the source editor.
markdown.heading_missing: Heading “{{heading}}” was not found in this note.
markdown.table_keys: Table keyboard controls (while this button is focused): arrows insert rows/columns; Shift+arrows move them. Backspace deletes the row; Delete deletes the column; Shift+Delete deletes the table. L, C and R align the column. Undo restores the previous edit.
notes.import_help: Select the local vault root, then choose the files and folders to import. Folder paths and journal/event associations are retained. Existing files are kept unless you enable overwrite and select them. Completed imports are retained if interrupted.
notes.import_reviewed: {{count}} new files ready to import. Review the list before continuing.
notes.import_done: Imported {{count}} files. Conflicts were left unchanged.
notes.webdav_credentials: Use a separate API token with read and write permissions as the WebDAV password. The username can be any nonempty value.
notes.webdav_naming: Daily and weekly notes are in the configured journal folder; calendar event notes are in the events folder. Other Markdown notes and attachments share the same collection.
notes.webdav_concurrency: Preview changes with the manual client before applying them. Existing files require their current ETag for updates or deletion; conflicting versions are retained for review.
typography.title: Font sizes
typography.description: Edit the commented CSS below to change text sizes. These preferences are saved to your account on the server and follow you when you sign in from another browser or device.
typography.help: The default is --font-base: 14px. Use --font-base: 100% to follow the browser default, or use a pixel value such as 18px to set the size of 1rem. Other rem values scale from it; em values scale from the surrounding text. Edit values inside :root, keeping the property names. Remove a property to use its default. Changes apply after the server confirms your save. Reset saves the defaults to your account.
typography.saved: Font sizes saved to your account.
typography.error.syntax: Use one :root { ... } block containing font properties and optional CSS comments. Keep the CSS under 64 KiB.
typography.error.property: Unknown font property: {{name}}. Use the names from the default CSS.
typography.error.duplicate: The font property {{name}} occurs more than once. Keep one value for each property.
typography.error.value: Enter a valid, nonzero CSS font size for {{name}}, such as 0.9rem or 14px. CSS math is supported; references and other CSS declarations are not.
typography.error.base: Set --font-base to a positive percentage or pixel value, such as 100% or 18px. This defines the size of 1rem.
typography.error.load: The default font size CSS could not be loaded. Reload this page to try again.
notes.import_limits: Markdown files can contain up to {{markdown}} bytes; other files up to {{file}} bytes. Larger files are skipped and identified below with their size and limit.
notes.import_hidden: Hidden files and configuration folders are skipped unless included by export metadata or enabled in Notes preferences.
notes.import_invalid_path: This is not a portable path inside the selected folder.
notes.import_metadata_invalid: The notes timestamp metadata is invalid or ambiguous. Prepare it again, or remove the metadata file to import using file modification dates.
notes.import_metadata_changed: Content changed after the timestamp snapshot; using the current file modification time.
notes.export_help: Prepare a ZIP containing all active notes, journal and event folders, and assets. Exact Markdown and relative paths are preserved. Timestamp metadata retains creation and modification dates when importing the extracted folder. Recently deleted items and account data are excluded.
notes.import_dates_help: File modification dates are preserved. Browsers do not expose filesystem creation dates. Without timestamp metadata, a new file records when it was added to Dagsverk; replacing a file keeps its existing creation date. Dagsverk exports include timestamp metadata. For a local vault, the manual client can prepare original timestamps before you choose the folder.
notes.import_reviewed_other: {{count}} new files ready to import. Review the list before continuing.
notes.import_done_other: Imported {{count}} files. Conflicts were left unchanged.
notes.import_reviewed_one: {{count}} new file ready to import. Review the list before continuing.
notes.import_done_one: Imported {{count}} file. Conflicts were left unchanged.
notes.import_not_present: This file was not provided by the folder picker. It may be hidden or no longer present; nothing will be uploaded.

notes.recent_days_help: Show ordinary, event and journal notes edited during this many calendar days, including today, in Today. Uses your account time zone. Choose 1–3650 days; the default is 7.
markdown.revision_delete_uncertain: Deletion may have completed. Close and reopen revisions to refresh the list.
markdown.diff_truncated: This comparison is too large to display in full. The source and draft are unchanged.
storage.title: Storage
storage.help: Notes collection usage includes journal notes, event notes, attachments and items kept in Trash.
storage.over_limit: Usage exceeds the current allowance. Existing files are retained, but further growth is blocked.
storage.shared_allowance: Each category uses the same shared account allowance. Trash continues to count until its retained data is removed.
storage.admin_help: These limits apply to each account, including retained Trash. Saved changes apply immediately across server instances. Authentication and mail settings are unaffected.
storage.upload_ceiling: The current server upload ceiling is {{limit}}.
storage.invalid_limits: Choose whole-byte limits. Markdown files must fit the file limit, the file limit must fit total storage, and at least four entries are required.
storage.error_http_limit: The file limit exceeds the server upload ceiling. Ask the server operator to increase the HTTP upload limit first.
calendar.sharing.setup: Choose Add calendar, give it a name, select a client and paste an HTTPS or webcal iCalendar subscription link. A calendar web page or sharing invitation will not work. Provider sign-in is optional.
calendar.sharing.title: Calendar subscriptions without sign-in
calendar.sharing.privacy: Subscription links can reveal calendar details to anyone who has them. Only add calendars you are allowed to share with this Dagsverk server, and keep the links private. Removing a subscription here does not revoke its link; stop publishing or reset the link at the provider.
calendar.sharing.microsoft.title: Microsoft 365 (Office 365 / Outlook)
calendar.sharing.microsoft.step1: In Outlook on the web, open Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars.
calendar.sharing.microsoft.step2: Under Publish a calendar, choose your calendar and the detail level you want Dagsverk to see, then select Publish.
calendar.sharing.microsoft.step3: Copy the ICS link and paste it into Calendar feed URL in Dagsverk.
calendar.sharing.microsoft.note: Your organisation may disable publishing. Ask your administrator if Publish a calendar is missing. An HTML link or an invitation to a named person cannot be used here.
calendar.sharing.google.title: Google Calendar
calendar.sharing.google.step1: On a computer, open Google Calendar → Settings. Select your calendar under Settings for my calendars, then Integrate calendar.
calendar.sharing.google.step2: Copy Secret address in iCal format and paste it into Calendar feed URL in Dagsverk. You do not need to make your calendar public.
calendar.sharing.google.note: Keep the secret address private. Reset it in Google Calendar if it is exposed, then update your Dagsverk subscription. For work or school accounts, your administrator may hide this option.
calendar.sharing.apple.title: Apple Calendar (iCloud)
calendar.sharing.apple.step1: On a computer or tablet, open Calendar on iCloud.com. Select the calendar information button beside your calendar.
calendar.sharing.apple.step2: Turn on Public Calendar and copy the link.
calendar.sharing.apple.step3: Paste the webcal link into Calendar feed URL in Dagsverk.
calendar.sharing.apple.note: Anyone with this link can view the calendar. Private iCloud invitations require an Apple Account and cannot be used here. Turn off Public Calendar to stop sharing.
calendar.sharing.tasks.title: Specialized task feeds
calendar.sharing.tasks.support: To-do items displays tasks only when the subscribed feed contains iCalendar to-dos (VTODO). They stay read-only: update their status in the source app. They do not create Dagsverk tasks or count as worked time.
calendar.sharing.tasks.providers: Google Tasks and Microsoft To Do are not included in calendar subscription feeds. Connect the provider under Internet accounts to synchronize those task lists. Apple Reminders also requires a separate connector.
calendar.sharing.tasks.setup: Only enable task items for a separate feed that explicitly supplies them. An ordinary Google or Microsoft calendar subscription supplies calendar events.
tasks.source_warning: Some calendars could not be refreshed. Available tasks are still shown. Check their status in My Account → Calendars.
tasks.unresolved_help: This task has an unknown time zone or an ambiguous clock time. Its original values are shown. Date-based views use only dates that can be resolved.
notes.search_changed: Search results changed or expired. Search again for current results.
notes.search_invalid: Use up to 32 words, quoted phrases or tag:, file:, event:, journal: and note: filters (up to 512 characters).
notes.search_unavailable: Content search is being prepared or is unavailable. Try again shortly; browsing files still works.
notes.creation_date_help: An original creation date is shown when supplied. Otherwise Dagsverk records when the item was added. Older entries may not identify which date was recorded.
notes.import_overwrite_help: Existing files are kept by default. Enable this to review replacements. Files changed or moved after review are kept and reported as conflicts.
notes.import_reviewed_overwrite: {{count}} files selected. Replacements: {{replacements}}. Review before importing.
notes.import_reviewed_overwrite_one: {{count}} file selected. Replacements: {{replacements}}. Review before importing.

markdown.plantuml_external: Diagram previews cannot load files, images, themes or external resources. Its Markdown source is preserved.
markdown.plantuml_invalid: The diagram could not be rendered. Edit its Markdown source to correct or simplify it.
notes.create_linked_confirm: The note “{{path}}” does not exist. Create it and open the editor?
notes.search_help: Search notes and event details. Use tag:#name, file:name, event:words, journal:words or note:words to narrow the results. Put phrases in double quotes.
notes.search_event_no_note: This event has no saved note.
task_providers.title: Internet accounts
task_providers.help: Connect your existing Google or Microsoft account. You still sign in to Dagsverk separately. No new provider account is needed.
task_providers.direction: Calendars and tasks synchronize separately. Choose task lists and review their first import before adding tasks to Dagsverk.
task_providers.not_configured: Some connections are not ready. Check the status below, or use a calendar subscription. Refresh status to check again.
task_providers.disconnect_help: Disconnecting stops synchronization and removes this account’s connected calendars from Dagsverk. Imported tasks are kept.
task_providers.disconnected: Disconnected. Imported tasks remain in Dagsverk.
task_providers.disabled: This connection is disabled. Reconnect to resume imports.
task_providers.list_missing: A selected list is no longer available. Tasks already imported from it are kept.
task_providers.no_lists: No task lists were found. Create a list at the provider, then refresh from the provider.
task_providers.connected: Connected. Choose which lists to import.
task_providers.not_confirmed: The connection could not be confirmed. Return to Internet accounts and check its status before trying again.
task_providers.reconnect_required: Reconnect this account and approve its selected calendar and task permissions to resume synchronization.
task_providers.authorization_expired: This connection attempt expired or belongs to another browser. Start a new connection.
task_providers.rate_limited: Wait a little before refreshing or connecting again. Existing tasks are kept.
task_providers.conflicts: Some tasks need review. Local edits and previously imported tasks are kept.
task_providers.choose_lists: Choose at least one task list to import tasks.
task_providers.busy: A refresh is already running. Its result will appear here.
task_providers.too_large: This task source exceeds the import limits. Existing tasks are kept.
task_providers.unavailable: The task provider could not be refreshed. Existing tasks are kept; try again later.
task_providers.paused: Synchronization is paused. Credentials and saved import progress are retained.
task_providers.preparing_import: Preparing {{name}}: {{count}} tasks read. No tasks have been imported yet.
task_providers.import_counts: {{created}} new tasks, {{existing}} existing matches, {{deleted}} deleted records.
task_providers.import_preview_help: Up to 20 task titles are shown. Import includes the complete list. Existing task projects are kept, children inherit their parent’s project, and deletions or conflicting edits require separate review.
task_providers.preview_not_ready: The list preview is still being prepared. Refresh status when synchronization finishes.
task_providers.preview_expired: This import preview expired. Refresh from the provider and review the new preview.
task_providers.direction_unsupported: Two-way synchronization is not available for this provider.
task_writes.title: Google write results
task_writes.help: Google changes are imported automatically. Review supported Dagsverk edits here before sending them. Other values stay in Dagsverk.
task_writes.no_tasks: No eligible tasks are available for this action.
task_writes.delete_help: This deletes the task from Google. Its ordinary Dagsverk task is kept for separate review. Assigned tasks must be deleted at their original document or chat.
task_writes.unknown_help: The original request may have reached Google. Check its current result; this does not resend the change. Reconciliation accepts the displayed values and keeps unrelated edits.
task_writes.warning_default: This value stays in Dagsverk and will not be sent.
task_writes.warning_TEXT_ONLY: Only plain text notes can be sent. These notes stay in Dagsverk.
task_writes.warning_FIELD_LIMIT: The value exceeds the Google limit and stays in Dagsverk.
task_writes.warning_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED: Google does not support this status.
task_writes.warning_NO_BASELINE: No common Google value is known. The local value is kept.
task_writes.warning_NOT_WRITABLE: Google cannot accept changes to this value.
task_writes.warning_INCOMPLETE_GROUP: Related values must be reviewed together before sending.
task_writes.warning_COMPLETION_GROUP: Completion and its time must be reviewed together.
task_writes.warning_ASSIGNED_TASK_NOTES: Notes on this assigned task must be edited at its original source.
task_writes.warning_DELETE_AT_ASSIGNMENT: Delete this task at its original document or chat.
task_writes.state_ACK_REVIEW: Google confirmed; local changes need review
task_writes.state_CONFLICT: Google changed; review a fresh proposal
task_writes.state_FAILED: Could not send; review before trying again
task_writes.state_STALE: Task or connection changed; prepare a new proposal
task_writes.no_changes: There are no supported changes to send.
task_writes.create_help: Create a Google task linked to this existing Dagsverk task. Your project, rich notes and other unsupported fields stay in Dagsverk. Only root tasks can be created; hierarchy and order stay local.
task_writes.unknown_create_help: Google may have created this task. Dagsverk will not send it again or import new identities from this list until you identify the result. Check Google, then search the fresh scan and explicitly choose the correct task ID. Matching titles alone do not establish identity.
task_writes.warning_LOCAL_HIERARCHY: Hierarchy and order stay in Dagsverk for a task created this way.
task_writes.warning_CREATE_PARENT_UNSUPP: Only root tasks can be created in Google. Keep this subtask in Dagsverk.
task_writes.identity_search: Search Google task titles or IDs
task_writes.candidates_count: Showing {{shown}} of {{count}} matching tasks. Refine the search if needed.
task_writes.choose_identity: Choose an exact Google task identity
task_writes.link_identity: Link this identity; keep Dagsverk fields
task_writes.scan_required: Check Google and wait for the full scan to finish, then search again.
task_writes.creation_pending: A creation proposal already exists for this task and list. Review it before preparing another.
task_writes.already_linked: This task is already linked to the selected Google list.
task_reviews.title: Incoming task reviews
task_reviews.help: Keep local values for conflicts, or use the observed {{provider}} values. Independent {{provider}} changes are accepted in either case. This decision sends no changes to {{provider}}. The comparison expires after 15 minutes; refresh synchronization to fetch a new one.
task_reviews.search: Filter by task title or {{provider}} identity
task_reviews.count: Showing {{shown}} of {{count}} decisions. Refine the filter to find more.
task_reviews.deleted: {{provider}} explicitly reported this task deleted. Review its Dagsverk copy before deciding.
task_reviews.other_sources: This task has other source links. Keep it here and review those links separately.
task_reviews.unresolved: This identity or hierarchy needs further review. Refresh synchronization or reconnect after restoring list access. No task will be removed automatically.
task_writes.leave_unresolved_help: If you cannot identify the Google result, you can stop holding new imports. The local task stays unlinked. This does not cancel the original Google request or prove that it failed. A late result may be imported as a separate task. The request will not be sent again automatically.
task_writes.leave_unresolved_ack: I understand that a Google result may appear as a separate imported task.
task_writes.unresolved_help: This request was left unresolved by your choice. Its outcome remains unknown. New imports are allowed; the original local task was not changed or linked.
task_identities.title: New task identities
task_identities.help: Import a new task or attach this identity to an existing Dagsverk task from the same account. Titles are never used to decide that two tasks are the same. Independent Google changes are accepted during replacement; conflicting local values stay. No changes are sent to Google.
task_identities.search: Filter by Google title or identity
task_identities.existing: Existing Dagsverk task and source link
task_identities.no_existing: No task has an eligible source link in this provider account.
task_identities.ack: Retain this Dagsverk task and replace only the selected source link.
task_identities.hierarchy: Replacement retains the native task ID, project and hierarchy. Hierarchy stays local for this identity. Unrelated or edited resources remain; observed source links are refreshed.
task_identities.previous_changed: That source link changed. Reload and review the current task before continuing.
task_identities.review_additions: Review new Google identities before importing (recommended)
task_identities.block_PARENT_UNRESOLVED: Import the provider parent first, or reconcile with a native task whose hierarchy will remain local.
task_identities.block_CREATE_IDENTITY_RE: Resolve the uncertain outgoing creation before deciding on new identities.
task_identities.block_LOCAL_DELETED: This identity belongs to a deliberately deleted local task. It will not be recreated.
internet_accounts.provider_help: Use your existing Google account to connect selected calendars and task lists. Calendar access is read-only; task imports are read-only unless you explicitly choose reviewed two-way Google Tasks access.
internet_accounts.subscription_help: Use an HTTPS or webcal calendar feed without signing in to a provider. Subscriptions are read-only and do not include Google Tasks or Microsoft To Do.
internet_accounts.calendars_saved: Calendar selection saved. Synchronization will start shortly.
internet_accounts.calendar_unreadable: This calendar is not currently readable. Previously synchronized events are kept.
internet_accounts.no_calendars: No calendars were found. Refresh from the provider after adding a calendar there.
internet_accounts.calendar_needs_client: Create a client before selecting calendars.
internet_accounts.calendar_refresh_faile: Calendars could not be refreshed. Previously synchronized events are kept. Try refreshing again or reconnect this account.
calendar.error.CALENDAR_PROVIDER_UNAVAIL: The connected account could not refresh this calendar. Existing events are kept. Check the account under Internet accounts.
calendar.error.CALENDAR_MANAGED_SOURCE: Manage this calendar under Internet accounts.
task_providers.sign_in_failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Return to Internet accounts and try connecting again.
internet_admin.help: Check the active OAuth mode, callback address, and Google/Microsoft registrations. Checking managed mode contacts its service without starting provider consent or reading personal data.
internet_admin.check_for_address: Check setup to find the service address
internet_admin.credentials_help: Shared sign-in is configured once for the service. Individual Dagsverk installations do not need a Google client ID or secret.
internet_admin.status_not_checked: The shared service has not been checked.
internet_admin.status_ready: Setup checks passed. Direct credentials are validated locally; provider consent confirms their acceptance. Each provider’s registration status is shown below.
internet_admin.status_public_origin_requ: Set the public HTTPS address in General settings, save it, and restart Dagsverk before connecting an account.
internet_admin.status_unavailable: Managed OAuth discovery, health, or registration checks failed. Retry Check setup, verify its deployment, or configure direct registration.
internet_admin.step_host: Host the shared sign-in service at a project-controlled HTTPS address.
internet_admin.step_google_project: In Google Cloud, enable Google Tasks API and Google Calendar API. Configure Google Auth Platform branding, audience and data access; add test users while the app is in Testing.
internet_admin.step_google_client: Create an OAuth client of type Web application. Register the Google authorized redirect URI shown above, ending in /oauth/google/callback.
internet_admin.step_service_environment: Set DAGSVERK_CONNECT_ORIGIN, DAGSVERK_CONNECT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, DAGSVERK_CONNECT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and a Base64-encoded 32-byte DAGSVERK_CONNECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the service’s private environment. Keep the encryption key with the service backup.
internet_admin.step_application: Publish the project’s service discovery file, or set DAGSVERK_CONNECT_SERVICE_URL on this installation and restart it. Use Check setup to confirm that the service reports a Google registration.
internet_admin.step_user: In Account → Internet accounts, choose Google calendars, tasks or both, connect, then save the selected calendars and task lists. Review the first task import. Google task writes are optional; calendars stay read-only.
internet_admin.live_check: Setup checks do not prove live consent or synchronization. Verify calendar-only, tasks-only and combined consent with existing test accounts, refresh, reconnect and private-browser return before rollout.
internet_admin.direct_help: Direct mode supports tasks only. Disable shared sign-in with DAGSVERK_CONNECT_SHARED=false, configure the Google client ID and secret for this installation, and register its return address in Google Cloud. Calendar synchronization requires the shared service.
internet_admin.edit_help: Choose the application’s OAuth mode and provider registrations here. Both modes authorize users’ existing accounts. Provider secrets are write-only; blank preserves them. Save and restart every server instance to activate changes.
internet_admin.secret_saved: A Google client secret is saved. Leave the new-secret field blank to keep it.
internet_admin.secret_missing: No Google client secret is saved.
internet_admin.secret_choice: Enter a new Google client secret or select Clear saved Google client secret.
internet_admin.service_override: Shared sign-in address override (blank uses project discovery)
internet_admin.restart_required: Settings saved. Restart every Dagsverk server instance to activate them. The setup check shows the currently active settings.
internet_admin.direct_callback: Google redirect URI for direct registration
internet_accounts.tasks_only_help: Sign in to synchronize task lists. Add a calendar subscription for calendar events.
task_providers.calendars_unsupported: This sign-in method supports tasks only. Add a calendar subscription for events.
password.passkey_help: Choose Existing passkey to set a new password without knowing your current password. Your browser will ask you to verify with a registered passkey.
today.no_headings: No headings in this note yet.
today.contents_unavailable: The table of contents is unavailable. Your note is still editable.
tasks.completion_stale: This task changed. Review its current state before changing completion.
notes.import_tasks_checkbox: Create tasks from their checkbox state
notes.import_tasks_completed: Create tasks and mark all completed
notes.import_tasks_ignore: Ignore tasks; do not create any
notes.import_tasks_help: Completed tasks use the file’s last modified date and check the source boxes. Ignored items stay unenrolled until their checkbox or title is edited. Existing linked tasks keep their identities.
internet_accounts.microsoft_help: Connect an existing Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live, or Microsoft 365 work/school account, subject to your organization’s consent rules. Calendars and Microsoft To Do are read-only. Email is not synchronized.
internet_accounts.ready: Ready to connect your existing account.
internet_accounts.connection_unavailable: The connection service is unavailable. Try Refresh status, or ask an administrator to check Internet account settings.
internet_accounts.origin_required: An administrator must configure the application’s HTTPS address before accounts can connect. Existing synchronized data remains available.
internet_accounts.callback_invalid: An administrator must correct the application’s HTTPS callback address before accounts can connect.
internet_admin.not_sso: Both modes connect each user’s existing provider accounts for calendars and tasks. They do not provide SSO or replace Dagsverk sign-in, and they do not synchronize email.
internet_admin.managed_help: The project-operated service owns the provider registrations for multiple installations. No per-installation OAuth application is needed. It requires a deployed, reachable broker with the selected provider configured. Use direct registration while this service is unavailable. The installation needs a stable HTTPS origin; its callback may be private over Tailscale.
internet_admin.self_managed_help: Recommended for independent self-hosting or when managed OAuth is unavailable. The administrator registers and maintains Google and/or Microsoft web applications, enables Calendar/Tasks APIs and consent/test users, and registers the exact HTTPS callback below, including its port. Users only authorize their existing accounts. A private Tailscale origin is supported when accepted by the provider and reachable from the browser. Save settings and restart to activate them.
internet_admin.microsoft_accounts: For Microsoft, register accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts. The common authorization endpoint supports Outlook.com/Hotmail/Live and Microsoft 365, subject to tenant consent. Configure delegated User.Read, Tasks.Read and/or Calendars.Read; no email permission is requested.
internet_admin.status_registration_requi: No provider registration is ready in the active mode. Configure a direct client ID and secret, or ask the managed-service operator to configure the provider.
internet_admin.status_callback_invalid: The effective HTTPS origin or callback is invalid. Correct the public HTTPS address and restart.
internet_accounts.registration_required: An administrator must configure this provider in Internet account settings before accounts can connect.
tasks.complete_visible_description_one: Complete {{count}} visible, unfinished task? Calendar tasks are read-only and are skipped. Tasks beyond Show more tasks are not included.
tasks.complete_visible_description_other: Complete {{count}} visible, unfinished tasks? Calendar tasks are read-only and are skipped. Tasks beyond Show more tasks are not included.
tasks.complete_visible_failed_one: {{count}} task confirmed completed before stopping: {{message}}. Refresh to review the current tasks before trying again.
tasks.complete_visible_failed_other: {{count}} tasks confirmed completed before stopping: {{message}}. Refresh to review the current tasks before trying again.
notes.association_tasks: Tasks from this note inherit its client and project. Changing this choice updates all linked tasks.
snippets.title: Text snippets
snippets.description: Type a keyword followed by a space in a note to expand it. Snippets use your account time zone. Remove all snippets to disable expansion.
snippets.help: Defaults: ;dt inserts date and time, ;dd inserts a date, ;tm inserts time. Add +7 for seven days or +1m for one month. Templates support Alfred-style {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {isodate:yyyy-MM-dd}, {isotime:HH:mm}, date arithmetic such as {date +1M:MMMM}, and {cursor}. M means months and m means minutes inside placeholders. Unsupported placeholders remain literal.
snippets.invalid: Use unique keywords, at most 8,192 characters per expansion and 64 KiB in total.
